summary: A 1948 galvanized steel lookout tower, 24.4 m, in York County, finished in 1950 with a telephone line. No source found describes the site today.

facts.design: Galvanized steel lookout tower with observer's living quarters and a cupola cabin
facts.agency: New Brunswick Department of Lands and Mines

events.note: 80 ft galvanized steel tower with observer's living quarters, with a telephone line built to the highway. Source: 112th annual report of the Department of Lands and Mines, as quoted on the page.
Roof put on the cupola cabin and the inside of the living quarters finished and painted; the report says this completed construction of the station.

evidence.supports: Built 1948: 80 ft galvanized steel lookout tower with observer's living quarters, about 2 miles north of Harvey Station
evidence.quote: 1948: "An 80 ft. galvanized steel lookout tower with observer's living quarters was built on Harvey Mountain about 2 miles north of Harvey Station.

evidence.supports: Telephone line of about 0.8 mile built on poles from the tower to the highway, connecting to the Harvey exchange
evidence.quote: About eight-tenths of a mile of telephone line metallic circuit on poles was built to connect the tower to the highway where connect is made with the Harvey exchange.

evidence.supports: 1950: new roof on the cupola cabin; living quarters finished and painted; completed construction of the station
evidence.quote: 1950: "At Harvey Mountain Lookout Station a new roof was put on the cupola cabin on top of the tower, the inside of the living quarters was finished and painted, completing the construction of this lookout station.

evidence.supports: Located in York County, New Brunswick (page heading for the tower)

notes_for_editor: Single secondary source: the Canada's Fire Lookouts page quotes New Brunswick Department of Lands and Mines annual reports (112th for 1948; 114th for 1950). The reports were not read directly. Two searches and several local-history pages (Harvey Rural Community, MyNewBrunswick, Harvey Heritage) gave nothing on the tower, its status or whether the site is public. Name check: an unfetched Provincial Archives of New Brunswick catalogue item, 'A circular map centered on the Mount Harvey fire tower' (search.canbarchives.ca), may be this lookout under another name; not confirmed. Canadian Register of Historic Places not searched.
